pr_body:
Solves #23946

Now, `/api/v1/instance` returns the same data as in the admin panel.

Also, `site_description` was removed from `config/settings.yml` since the field wasn't used anywhere in the codebase.


https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34009891/229510447-0d2b325a-77e2-455c-81a1-7167bdb490ef.mp4
pr_comments:
> One issue is that IIRC the `description` field of `/api/v1/instance` is supposed to be plain text, while the extended description supports Markdown. This is probably a lesser issue than a description you can't update, though.

Hey @ClearlyClaire, thank you for your reply. I'm a little confused, so is this PR ok and there is another issue related to the markdown support for the `extended_description`, or this issue is part of the actual problem related by @ledlamp.

Also, I have more PR's open, could you take a look when you have time? :smile: 

https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/pull/24242
https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/pull/24240

> Hey @ClearlyClaire, thank you for your reply. I'm a little confused, so is this PR ok and there is another issue related to the markdown support for the `extended_description`

What I meant is I believed that `site_description` was meant to be plain-text.

But I was mistaken, `Setting.site_description` did allow HTML. `Setting.site_extended_description` is Markdown-formatted though, so it should be rendered as HTML before being served in `/api/v1/instance`. See `REST::ExtendedDescriptionSerializer` for how it's done.

Closing due to lack of activity.

If you want to nudge forward, can you rebase, re-open this issue, and address the prior review feedback?

issue_context.title: site_description orphaned in db, outdated "description" in /api/v1/instance
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce the problem

look at `/api/v1/instance`

### Expected behaviour

info matches everything on admin panel

### Actual behaviour

there's an orphaned field from an older version of mastodon that can't be edited anymore

### Detailed description

It seems since some upgrade the value of `site_description` in `settings` in the db can't be changed anymore, but this value is **still used** in `/api/v1/instance`, so some things might use an outdated description that the server admin has no way of changing, besides manually accessing the database.

For example, look at https://mstdn.social/api/v1/instance; the `"description"` is obviously out of date.
![2023-03-03_15-38-13-921 httpsmstdn socialapiv1instance_-_Google_Chrome](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/103386533/222856405-a64c3361-08b8-4fb7-9323-39dbb8ddf7ba.png)

I found this out because AodeRelay v0.3.8 used a very old description that was nowhere in the admin ui, and I was confused until I found it in `/api/v1/instance`.

According to docs https://docs.joinmastodon.org/entities/V1_Instance/#description it's "An HTML-permitted description of the Mastodon site" so... should it not be populated by the "extended description" on `/admin/settings/about`?

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/103386533/222857212-b52b829c-2f61-4f28-a6f5-53268f1fb929.png)



https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/blob/aa98c8fbeb02fecac2681464fd7c0445deb466b1/app/serializers/rest/v1/instance_serializer.rb#L23-L25

### Specifications

v4.1.0
